svg.title: fig restore right left
svg.desc:
Before above: black yellow above a red violet right child, whose left child is red blue. After below: red blue above black yellow and black violet. The green, orange, pink, and cyan subtrees retain their left-to-right order.
Source (split): tree: black/(k3,v3) a red/(k1,v1) red/(k2,v2) b c d
